data.name: WarningCodicilRealEstate
data.value: You chose a codicil, but you have real estate. Distribution of real estate is only legally valid through a notarial will (art. 4:97 Civil Code).

data.name: WarningHandwrittenExecutor
data.value: You have designated an executor in a handwritten will. An executor can only receive 'three-star powers' (management, distribution, liquidation) through a notarial will.

data.name: WarningNoExclusionClause
data.value: You have children but no exclusion clause. Without an exclusion clause, your children's inheritance may fall into the community of property during a divorce.

data.name: WarningPercentageMismatch
data.value: The beneficiary percentages total {0}% (expected: 100%). This may lead to ambiguity about the distribution.

data.name: WarningNoNotary
data.value: No notary has been entered for the will. A notary is required for a valid notarial will.

data.name: SuggestionConsiderNotarialWill
data.value: Consider having a notarial will drawn up.

data.name: SuggestionIncludeExecutorInNotarialWill
data.value: Have the executor appointment included in a notarial will.

data.name: SuggestionCheckPercentages
data.value: Check the distribution and ensure percentages add up to 100%.

data.name: WarningExecutorAlsoBeneficiary
data.value: The following person(s) are both executor and beneficiary, which may create a conflict of interest: {0}.

data.name: SuggestionExecutorConflict
data.value: Consider appointing an independent executor who does not benefit from the estate.

data.name: WarningPartnerNotBeneficiary
data.value: You are married or have a registered partnership, but your partner is not listed as a beneficiary in the will.

data.name: SuggestionAddPartnerBeneficiary
data.value: Consider adding your partner as a beneficiary or verify that this omission is intentional.

data.name: WarningNoBeneficiaries
data.value: No beneficiaries are specified in the will. Without beneficiaries, the distribution of the estate is unclear.

data.name: SuggestionAddBeneficiaries
data.value: Add one or more beneficiaries to the will.

data.name: SuggestionFillContactDetails
data.value: Fill in contact details so heirs can be reached.
